componentAcceptance: All T23 criteria are covered. Existing bounded reads, pagination, Chinese/binary content, replacement limits and artifact quota remain intact. The new machine.artifact path performs artifact_stat then a scoped full read, verifies exact size and SHA-256, caps downloads at 1 MiB and returns ARTIFACT_DOWNLOAD_EXPIRED for missing artifacts. Another Bot cannot read the artifact. The product UI uses the same Bot-scoped action and renders only a verified download link, never raw content; missing/expired artifacts produce explicit feedback. Related artifact and UI tests pass 28/28 and the full root regression has zero failures.
productAcceptance: T23 passes at integration level. Downloads are authorized and hash-verified with explicit missing/expiry feedback, not arbitrary file reads. Formal scores are 0/20 work packages, 16/63 scenarios and M0 11/12.
implementation: remote-machines.download validates closed identifiers, calls artifact_stat, enforces the 1 MiB download cap, reads the complete artifact through the original scope and verifies exact size and SHA-256 before returning bytes.
Missing artifacts become ARTIFACT_DOWNLOAD_EXPIRED; corruption and out-of-scope access stay refused.
machine.artifact binds the action to the owning Bot, and the UI emits only a data download link after verification with explicit expiry feedback and no content display.
The call contract now includes artifactId in its closed field set, and the generated client bundle is rebuilt and checked.
testRuns: remote-machines + bot-runtime-ui + product-client-build: 28 tests / 28 pass / 0 fail.
npm run build:client and npm run check:client: generated bundle verified.
Final npm test: phase one 1591/1587/0/4 and phase two 386/303/0/83; total 1977 tests, 1892 pass, 0 fail, 83 skipped.
preservedFailures: The initial download test exposed that call() omitted artifactId from its allowed fields; the closed contract now accepts it without opening any additional identifiers.
The UI test initially used onChange with an incompatible event sequence; the component now handles text input through onInput and the real download/expiry flows pass.
limitations: Downloads are capped at 1 MiB and limited to original authorized artifacts. This is not a streaming large-file downloader or public unauthenticated link.
No real model inference, production process, push or release was used.
